title: decree router request
description: request.json: the question decree asks a router for a `model` invoke, written in the router's child run folder (runs/<child id>/request.json) and named to its scripts by DECREE_REQUEST. The router answers with reply.json (reply.schema.json). Reference: docs/reference/runs.md, Model.

options.description: The state's transitions except `unsure` and `error`, in name order: the events the router may pick from.

event.description: The option: an event of the state.

description.description: The transition's `description`: what picking it means.

min_confidence.description: The `model` invoke's `min_confidence`, when it sets one: a reply with a lower or missing `confidence` produces `unsure`.

input.description: The latest script output of the invoke's `output` state, as logged (stdout, and stderr lines with their `[stderr] ` prefix); empty when the invoke names no `output`.

message_body.description: The parent message's body, kept apart from `input`.

history.description: One `<from>: <event>` entry for each `transition` event of the asking run so far, in order, except the claim.

reply_schema.description: The exact JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for this request's reply.json: `reason` a string, `event` one of the options, `confidence` a number from 0 to 1 and `probabilities` a number per option, in that order (a constrained decoder emits properties in schema order, so the model reasons before it picks); only `event` is required, and no other key is allowed. A typed router hands it unchanged to a constrained decoder. reply.schema.json is the general shape of every reply.
